construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored for this build; no copied code or external files read

shared_schema.input: Envelope plus safety_rules, meter_interval_csv, scada_telemetry. Exact object keys are checked. Grid assets contain asset_id, kind, critical, upstream_id. Asset IDs must match SYN-[A-Z0-9-]+. Outage reports contain report_id, asset_id, description, customers_affected, outage_active, safety_flags.
shared_schema.output: Envelope plus status, meter_readings, telemetry, method. Identifiers become request-local asset_ref/upstream_ref/report_ref aliases. Reports include sentiment score, label, matched lexicon contributions and safety priority/reason.
shared_schema.meter_csv: timestamp,device_id,consumption_kwh,season; timezone-aware half-hour boundaries; nonnegative finite interval kWh; unique device/timestamp pairs
shared_schema.telemetry_json: List of asset_id, timestamp, voltage_v, state; timezone-aware timestamp; nonnegative finite voltage; normal/alarm/offline; unique asset/timestamp pairs
shared_schema.emissions: Each figure must include finite nonnegative value, kgCO2e or tCO2e unit, and nonempty source. Figures are supplied estimates, not calculated or independently verified.
shared_schema.validation: validate(document, direction) is the shared boundary; validates input before transformation and checks emitted output safety and score invariants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single integrated stage: validated entity graph and CSV rows feed lexicon sentiment, then safety-first ranking, then identifier-protected output validation.

behavior.sentiment: Fixed lexicon integer sum. Immediate preceding not/never/no reverses contribution. Positive/negative/zero determines label. Matching vocabulary and contributions are shown, not original text.
behavior.safety_rules: fire, downed_line, medical_dependency => priority 1 regardless of tone or active status; other active outage => 2; otherwise => 3. Declared rules cannot weaken these tiers.
behavior.ranking: Priority ascending, customers_affected descending, sentiment score ascending, generated report_ref ascending.
behavior.protection: All asset identifiers, including critical ones, become request-local aliases. Report descriptions and original report IDs are omitted; known asset IDs in emissions provenance are replaced. Errors are generic and never echo input values.
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic topology, fictitious IDs, winter/summer 30-minute consumption and SCADA-style telemetry.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout; status ok and exit 0 on success; status error and exit 2 on validation/file errors.

limitations: Safety flags must be supplied by a responsible upstream process.
Aliases are request-local, not encrypted identifiers.
Protection minimizes known identifiers; this is not a general-purpose sensitive-data detector.
Input files themselves contain synthetic raw identifiers and require appropriate storage controls outside this reference.
An additional prompt log was recorded at docs/My_prompt.txt.
